product.name: Online Food Ordering System
product.description: A platform enabling restaurants to accept and manage online orders, integrating with delivery and payment partners for streamlined operations.

product.name: E-commerce Store Builder
product.description: A tool for businesses to create and manage professional online stores without upfront costs or technical skills.

product.name: Social Media Ordering Integration
product.description: A solution that allows businesses to accept direct orders from social media platforms like Instagram and WhatsApp through a unified system.

product.name: Delivery Automation with Local Partners
product.description: Integration with local delivery services to automate order dispatch, tracking, and real-time customer updates.

product.name: Online Payment Integration
product.description: Secure integration with multiple payment gateways to facilitate online transactions directly into business bank accounts.

product.name: Marketing Automation Tools
product.description: Features to automate marketing campaigns, including coupons, loyalty programs, and referral campaigns to increase customer engagement and sales.
